# powl_freq

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

A POWL node's multiplicity/frequency tag (Freq): how many times it may occur.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `min_freq` | `integer` | yes | Minimum occurrence count; 0 means the node is skippable. |
| `max_freq` | `integer` | no | Maximum occurrence count; absent means unbounded. |
